static_traits.name: Chen Yu
static_traits.family_status: 原籍伦敦，现居奥地利维也纳
static_traits.social_status: 有一位最好的朋友可倾诉关系问题
static_traits.medical_history: 此前without类似心理问题与治疗经历；without显著身体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好、配合度高，能进行自我Reflection与证据检视；语气平和

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续害怕我的Male友not再爱我，虽然我们已经在一起5年。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize this fear is affecting my mental health and our relationship, so I am seeking counseling to resolve this fear.

core_beliefs: I will be abandoned by my partner

special_situations.event: 晚上本应一起相处时，Male友仍专注于工作
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他在我们相处的时间选择工作，说明他not爱我、关系在恶化
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strongly focuses on whether he provides companionship, repeatedly communicates with him and requests more verbal expression to obtain confirmation

special_situations.event: Male友表示想一个人待着、需要Being alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他选择Being alone，就是在疏远我、准备离开我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 再次与他谈话表达自己的担忧与需求，寻求保证以缓解not安

special_situations.event: Male友说“我爱你”的频率明显下降
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 爱必须通过频繁的言语肯定来证明；如果他not常说，就表示not再爱我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 直接要求更多口头肯定，反复确认他是否爱我

special_situations.event: Male友有时选择工作而not是与我共度时光
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他not优先选择我，就说明我对他not重要、他not爱我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores evidence of him expressing care in other ways, continuing to focus on negative cues to seek certainty

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be loved and affirmed stably and explicitly (especially verbal 'I love you')
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被抛弃，担心亲密关系突然失去
defense_goal: 通过not断寻求言语确认与陪伴来维持关系安全、降低被抛弃的风险

object_relations.self_representation: 在关系中感到not被爱的、not安全的伴侣
object_relations.object_representation: 冷淡/疏离、被工作占据、较少言语表达的伴侣

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师询问其证据并挑战“他not爱我/会离开我”的想法，或讨论Male友忙碌、减少说“我爱你”时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向将对方的沉默与忙碌理解为拒绝与疏离（移情：将内在not安投向对方意图）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以Anxiety而求证的语气反复强调“他not爱我”，请求确认与安慰；在被挑战时给出表面Rationalization解释，但仍回到担忧的主题。

manifestations: 在亲密关系中强烈依赖对方的言语肯定以对抗Loneliness与not安全感
当Male友忙于工作或选择Being alone时显著triggerLoneliness感与被忽视的体验
outcomes: 晚间Anxiety worsened、日常生活受干扰

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将“爱需要频繁口头肯定”视为关系的硬性标准
倾向以“他应该更常说‘我爱你’”来衡量亲密与安全

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复担心关系、谨慎求证，但仍难以放下Anxiety
担心沟通后也not会改变，从而持续监控对方表达与行为

positive_force: 伴侣在非言语层面依然体贴与周到（关注与照顾仍存在）
有一位最好的朋友可提供情感支持与倾诉渠道
愿意主动寻求专业帮助并配合记录、证据检视等练习
能Identify automatic thoughts并考虑替代解释（认知灵活性一定程度存在）
negative_force: Over-relies on external verbal affirmation (External Validation) as the only proof of love
Cognitive distortion: Jumping to Conclusions/Mind Reading
对not确定性的耐受度低，晚间Anxiety显著
持续担忧导致注意力受损、Decline in work performance并加剧Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: 关系Anxiety与反复担心“伴侣not爱我/将离开我”
antecedent: 晚上与伴侣相处时更易被trigger
伴侣忙于工作、减少陪伴
伴侣减少说“我爱你”的频率
target_behavior.core_reason: Treats verbal affirmation as the core standard of love and relationship security, relying on external validation; cognitive biases of 'Jumping to Conclusions / Mind Reading' exist.
target_behavior.function: 寻求安慰与确认，以获得安全感并维持亲密；逃避not确定性与Loneliness感
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、Relationship tension、注意力受损，日常生活受影响
